(Search snippet content — full report 403'd on direct fetch via both curl and WebFetch; IEA's own Oil Market Report language, October 2026)

Robust Gulf of Oman ship-to-ship transfers helped lift total oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz by 3.7 mb/d to 10.9 mb/d. The swift return of East-West pipeline flows increased overall bypass exports by 970 kb/d to 5.6 mb/d.

Due to heightened security concerns amid increased Houthi attacks in the region in October, projections for the remainder of the year have been left largely unchanged.

Global oil supply increased by 2.5 mb/d m-o-m to 102.3 mb/d in September, driven by Gulf producers, and global oil supply is expected to average 101.4 mb/d over the second half of the year, up from 96.4 mb/d in 2Q26.
